method: Actual encoded133checkpoint contact sheet, ten scene midpoints, sixteen-frame progression sheet, six360px decoded samples and three enlarged decoded frames inspected with view_image. Comparison against inspected V2 motion/scene sheets.
findings: Blank signature line persists into hand adaptation; source report enters after mechanism rather than replacing the explanatory field.
Baltimore keeps both named people while an interrupted conceptual line and assurance question evolve through appearance/proof, prior travel confirmation and discretionary release.
Right-role wrapping corrected; important question and release labels remain separated from portraits and evidence notes.
Essential question labels and48px speech remain legible in360px reduced samples; original newspaper detail is supplementary, not necessary to read for understanding.
Illness labels, source distinctions, arrival versus later danger and shared agency payoff remain legible in actual encoded samples.
editorialJudgment: V3 meaningfully improves object continuity and the mobile hierarchy while preserving the exact story and audio. Retain documentary source-object approach and restrained motion; staged threats, physical gates, countdowns or invented pursuit would imply unsupported witnessed events. No additional spectacle justified.
limitations: Sampled desktop/360px proxies are not actual mobile/nativeUI/crop proof or continuous human playback.
Within-sentence caption sync is approximate; byte-identical audio preserves V2 delivery rather than granting pronunciation/prosody approval.
Contact sheets demonstrate object-state progression, not a prediction of audience retention.
